description.value: Whistler Blackcomb is North America's largest ski resort and a world-renowned four-season mountain destination operated by Vail Resorts. In summer it transforms into a major cycling hub anchored by the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, offering lift-accessed trail riding across both mountains. Touring cyclists passing through Whistler will find a full resort village with dining, rentals, and guest services at the mountain base.
